items.title: BofA’s Hartnett sets three conditions for a return to risk-taking
items.summary: Investing.com -- Investors should stay risk-off until three conditions are met to reverse the tightening of financial conditions, Bank of America’s top investment strategist Michael Hartnett says, including the end of the central banks’ rate-hiking cycle, the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield falling below 4.5%, and oil dropping below $80 a barrel.
